lines: This plan covers 7 days, starting today.
You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Bright chickpea pepper salad
dishes.title: Chickpeas, peppers, cucumber and corn tortillas
dishes.method: Mix the chickpeas, sliced peppers, cucumber and sweetcorn with lemon, olive oil and parsley. Serve with the corn tortillas.
dishes.why: A quick named plate fills Wednesday lunch before the first cooking session.

dishes.name: Tuna pepper tortilla plate
dishes.title: Tuna, peppers, cucumber and corn tortillas

dishes.why: This own plate keeps Wednesday lunch ready without asking the student to cook before the evening session.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil supper
dishes.title: Lentils, courgettes, peppers and tomatoes

preparations.title: Lentil, pepper and courgette stew
preparations.method: Heat the oil in a large pot and soften the onions, carrots and peppers. Add the lentils, tomatoes, water, paprika and cumin, bring to a simmer and cook until the lentils are tender. Stir in the courgettes for the final few minutes, season, cool promptly and weigh into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Paprika chicken with courgettes
preparations.method: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with paprika, cumin and salt. Brown it in the oiled pan, add the onions, courgettes and water, cover and cook until the chicken is fully done. Cool promptly and weigh the cooked chicken into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Chickpea, courgette and pepper pot
preparations.method: Soften the onions and peppers in the oil in a large pot. Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, water, cumin and paprika, simmer until thick, then fold in the courgettes and spinach until tender. Cool promptly and weigh into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Pan chicken with peppers
preparations.method: Cut and season the chicken with paprika, cumin and salt. Brown it in batches in the oiled pan, add the onions, peppers, courgettes and water, cover and cook until fully done. Cool promptly and weigh the cooked chicken into the named boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the lentil pot with onions, carrots, peppers, tomatoes, lentils and water. While it simmers, season and brown the chicken in the second pan, then add its onions, courgettes and water. Finish both, cool promptly, weigh the named portions into boxes and refrigerate.

Start the chickpea pot with onions, peppers, tomatoes, chickpeas and spices. While it simmers, brown the chicken in batches in the second pan, then add its onions, peppers, courgettes and water. Finish both, cool promptly, weigh the named portions into boxes and refrigerate.
